data.title: DRD
data.description: DRD (Digital Retail Display) bridges online convenience with local in-store shopping — letting shoppers discover nearby stores, check real-time stock, and buy instantly, while helping local retailers go digital without any technical expertise.
highlights: Real-time inventory visibility across nearby stores
Fast digital checkout with pickup or delivery options
Simple retailer dashboard for product and order management
Fair revenue-sharing model for local businesses
